scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:node && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.install:clean: rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml out dist coverage && pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:app
scripts.postinstall: node scripts/sync-biome-schema.mjs && electron-builder install-app-deps && node scripts/build-native.mjs --only=crypto
scripts.build:mac:arm64: pnpm run build:native:arm64 && pnpm run build:app && bash scripts/gstreamer/package-macos.sh --relocate-node && pnpm run build:helperd && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config
scripts.build:mac:x64: pnpm run build:native:x64 && pnpm run build:app && bash scripts/gstreamer/package-macos.sh --relocate-node && pnpm run build:helperd && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config
scripts.build:linux:x64: pnpm run build:native:x64 && pnpm run build:app && pnpm run build:helperd && electron-builder --linux AppImage --x64 --publish never --config
scripts.build:linux:arm64: pnpm run build:native:arm64 && pnpm run build:app && pnpm run build:helperd && electron-builder --linux AppImage --arm64 --publish never --config
scripts.coverage: pnpm run coverage:main && pnpm run coverage:renderer
